# Data simulation

## Parameters

```{r}
popSize <- 1000
df.params <- expand.grid(cull_frc=seq(0,1,0.01),
                         PA=seq(0,1,0.05), 
                         rep=seq(1,100),
                         accuracy_sel=NA,TPR=NA, TNR=NA)
```

- `cull_frc` corresponds to the fraction of the population selected (top values first).

- `PA` corresponds to the predictive ability (pearson correlation)

- `accuracy_sel` corresponds to the accuracy of selection (percentage of the population rightfully selected or discarded).

## Simulate two variables and make selection

One is observed and one is predicted, do it in such way that the correlation between the two is corresponding to the predictive ability

```{r}
mu <- c(0, 0)
for(r in unique(df.params$rep)){
  set.seed(56+r)
  for(pa in unique(df.params$PA)){
    Sigma <- matrix(c(1.0, pa,pa, 1.0), nrow = 2)
    sim <- mvrnorm(n = popSize, mu = mu, Sigma = Sigma)
    for(cull in unique(df.params$cull_frc)){
      ## all inds above the threshold are selected
      data <- as.data.frame(sim)
      data$obsFac <- ifelse(sim[,1] >= quantile(sim[,1], probs = cull), "sel","non-sel")
      data$predFac <- ifelse(sim[,2] >= quantile(sim[,2], probs = cull), "sel","non-sel")
      acc <- nrow(data[data$obsFac == data$predFac,])/popSize
      tpr <-  nrow(data[data$obsFac == "sel" & data$predFac == "sel",])/nrow(data[data$obsFac == "sel",])
      tnr <-  nrow(data[data$obsFac == "non-sel" & data$predFac == "non-sel",])/nrow(data[data$obsFac == "non-sel",])
      # confMat <- caret::confusionMatrix(data=factor(data$predFac, c("sel","non-sel")),
      #                                   reference=factor(data$obsFac, c("sel","non-sel")))
      ## add the value in the table
      idx <- which(df.params$PA == pa & df.params$cull_frc == cull & df.params$rep == r)
      df.params$accuracy_sel[idx] <- acc
      df.params$TPR[idx] <- tpr
      df.params$TNR[idx] <- tnr
    }
  }
}
saveRDS(df.params, here("output","simul_pred-ability_response_culling.rds"))

df.params.avg <- df.params |> 
  group_by(PA, cull_frc) |> 
  summarize(accuracy_sel=mean(accuracy_sel),
            TPR=mean(TPR), TNR=mean(TNR),.groups="drop")
```

## Plot results

```{r}
cor(df.params.avg$accuracy_sel, df.params.avg$TPR)


ggplot(df.params.avg, aes(x=cull_frc, y=accuracy_sel, color=PA, group=PA))+
  geom_point() + geom_line()+
  scale_color_viridis_c()+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent())+
  #scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent())+
  labs(x="Selected percentage", y="Accuracy \n(correctly selected and discarded)",
       color="Predictive ability")+
  guides(color=guide_colourbar(theme = theme(
    legend.key.width  = unit(15, "lines"),
    legend.key.height = unit(1, "lines"))))+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))
ggsave(here("output","figures","simulation_accuracy-selection_PA_culling.png"),
       width=6, height=5)


```

                        cull_frc > 0.25 & cull_frc < 0.75)

df.params.avg |> filter(PA >= 0.15 & PA < 0.2, cull_frc==0.6) |> DT::datatable()
